PoBR scales the Eternal Rage an Absent Amulet grants ("Grants Skill: Level N Eternal Rage") down to the level the character's attributes reach; PoB2 also keeps the plain gem group at the undowngraded level, and Rage regeneration follows the level (ceaseless_rage_base_rage_regeneration_per_minute, 300 at level 20) (docs/maintainer-guide.md, granted skills)

0.5 leech uses the strongest active instance, with one-second base recovery and no 10%-of-pool amount cap; amount and speed are separate (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Leech; https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3932540; https://poe2db.tw/us/Keywords). The oracle stacks instances and retains the old pool-based instance cap. Default rate ceilings remain the documented compatibility convention. base_mana_leech_amount_+% increases the amount, not the maximum rate: 162.96 rather than 190.12.
